vectors.name: hdr_normal
vectors.description: TIME 0x00ABCDEF, FLAGS 0.

vectors.name: hdr_time_zero
vectors.description: TIME is the host's microsecond clock, low 32 bits; 0 is valid.

vectors.name: hdr_time_max
vectors.description: The clock wraps every 71.6 minutes; boards handle the wrap.

vectors.name: hdr_flag_hint
vectors.description: A valid header. A board that doesn't know a hint processes the frame as usual. Hosts send FLAGS 0 until a hint is defined.

vectors.name: hdr_flag_rw
vectors.description: A valid header. Today's boards take the clock sync but ignore every slot of the frame and keep their lock. Hosts must not send it yet.

vectors.name: hdr_bad_crc
vectors.description: Same as hdr_normal with the last TIME bit flipped: the CRC-8 no longer matches.

vectors.name: hdr_version1
vectors.description: Protocol v1 (header first, withdrawn). The CRC is correct, but a v2 board rejects every frame of another version: no lock, no clock sync, no slot.

vectors.name: hdr_bad_magic
vectors.description: MAGIC 0x5BD2 instead of 0x5AD2.

vectors.name: slot_nop
vectors.description: A valid slot that does nothing (idle frames). LIGHT 0, SEQ 0.

vectors.name: slot_dark
vectors.description: 256 zero bits. Deliberately not a valid slot: every board ignores it.

vectors.name: slot_light_def
vectors.description: Roles CH1-CH5 = red, green, blue, warm white, cold white (2 3 4 7 6), gamma 2.8 (2800), flags 0, min power 0 and max power 65535 on every channel. SEQ 0x11.

vectors.name: slot_set
vectors.description: Flags 0x01 (smoothstep). M = 49151 (0.75), A = 65535 26214 0 0 0, B = 65535 x 5, duration 1000 ms, start +30 ms after this frame's TIME. SEQ 0x22.

vectors.name: slot_effect_pulse
vectors.description: Effect 1, start +30 ms (int32). Parameters: on 500 ms (u24), off 500 ms (u24), interval 1000 ms (u24), min 0, max 65535. SEQ 0x33.

vectors.name: slot_effect_breathe
vectors.description: Effect 6, start +30 ms. Parameters: period 5000 ms (u24), min 6553 (0.1), max 65535. SEQ 0x34.

vectors.name: slot_effect_strobe
vectors.description: Effect 2, start +30 ms, step count 2. The steps follow as STEP slots with the same SEQ 0x35.

vectors.name: slot_step
vectors.description: Index 0, count 2, duration 100 ms, transition 0 ms, M 65535, A = red, B = 65535 x 5. SEQ = the strobe EFFECT's SEQ 0x35.

vectors.name: slot_config
vectors.description: LIGHT 0xF (board). Pairs (id, value): PWM preset 8 (25 kHz), stagger 4 (adaptive + spread), LED current CH1-CH3 3000 mA, CH4-CH5 5000 mA, board limit 8000 mA; the 9th pair unused (0, 0). SEQ 0x44.

vectors.name: slot_identify_on
vectors.description: Value 1: blink the identify pattern (30 s). SEQ 0x55.

vectors.name: slot_identify_cal
vectors.description: Value 2, argument 0: the standard test at 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 %. Boards without the input current sense ignore it. SEQ 0x56.

vectors.name: slot_identify_dark
vectors.description: Value 3, argument 10: fade to dark and hold 10 s (or until value 4, RELEASE). SEQ 0x57.

vectors.name: slot_scene
vectors.description: Mode 1, cross-fade 10 x 100 ms, M 32768, A = 0 0 0 65535 32768 (warm-ish white), B = 65535 x 5. SEQ 0x66.

vectors.name: slot_light_opt
vectors.description: Flags 0x01. CW LED 153.8 mireds (6500 K) = 1538, WW LED 370.4 mireds (2700 K) = 3704, warm end 555.6 mireds (1800 K) = 5556, red assist 19661 (30 %). SEQ 0x77.

vectors.name: slot_light_opt_points
vectors.description: Flags 0x03. As slot_light_opt plus 3 points (M, mireds x 10): (65535, 3704) 2700 K at full, (16384, 4545) 2200 K at 25 %, (3277, 5556) 1800 K at 5 %; the 4th point unused (0, 0). SEQ 0x78.

vectors.name: frame_1board_set
vectors.description: Board 0: slot_set. Header TIME 0x00ABCDEF.

vectors.name: frame_3board_mixed
vectors.description: Board 0: slot_light_def. Board 1: slot_effect_breathe. Board 2: NOP (nothing to do). The first board sees all 104 bytes, the second 72, the third 40.

vectors.name: frame_config
vectors.description: Board 0: slot_config.

vectors.name: frame_effect
vectors.description: Board 0: slot_effect_pulse.

vectors.name: frame_idle_2boards
vectors.description: Keep-alive / refresh frame when there is nothing to send: NOP in every slot.

vectors.name: frame_preamble_dark_2boards
vectors.description: The start-up preamble for 2 boards is 10 of these frames (4 x N + 2), each with a fresh TIME. DARK slots are zero bits and never valid.
